name: @gqlize/lint
description: The repo's eslint flat config, and the TypeScript the linter runs on.
//typescript: Not the version the repo builds with. typescript-eslint's type-aware rules are written against the TypeScript 5 JS compiler API, and typescript@7 -- the native port -- no longer ships one: its package entry exports `version` and nothing else. Declaring 5.9 here rather than at the root is what keeps the two apart, because pnpm resolves typescript-eslint's `typescript` peer from this package. TS 5.9 reads every tsconfig in the repo (nothing here is 7-only), so the linter sees the same types tsc does.
